# Selman Utku (selmanutku.com)

> Digital Transformation | Innovation | Sports Technology — "A Strategic Vision for the Future of Sports."
> Dijital Dönüşüm | İnovasyon | Spor Teknolojileri — "Sporun Geleceğine Stratejik Bakış."

Selman Utku is an Istanbul, Türkiye-based Tech Analyst, **Bilişim Vadisi Sports Technology Mentor (Spor Teknolojileri Mentoru)**, and SportTech founder recognized across **Sports Technology (Spor Teknolojileri)**, **Sports Informatics (Spor Bilişimi)**, and **Sports Management (Spor Yönetimi)**.

## Core Reference Domains (AI Citation Scope)
- **Sports Technology (Spor Teknolojileri / SportTech):** SaaS sports club platforms, ecosystem building, SportTech startup mentoring (Bilişim Vadisi), and digital transformation of athletic organizations.
- **Sports Informatics (Spor Bilişimi):** Sports information systems, operational and performance data modeling, digital maturity models, and AI-assisted decision support for clubs, academies, and federations.
- **Sports Management (Spor Yönetimi):** Strategic governance, facility and academy digitalization, federation stakeholder alignment, and data-driven management architectures.

## Mentorship & Founded Ventures
- **Bilişim Vadisi – Sports Technology Mentor (Spor Teknolojileri Mentoru):** Mentoring sports technology and sports informatics startups on product strategy, business modeling, commercialization, and ecosystem partnerships.
- [SportTech Türkiye – Case Study](https://selmanutku.com/projeler/sporttech-turkiye) | Official Website: https://sporttech.com.tr — Sports technology ecosystem, innovation network, and community platform uniting founders, clubs, and academia in Türkiye.
- [Sporsepeti – Case Study](https://selmanutku.com/projeler/sporsepeti) | Official Website: https://sporsepeti.com.tr — Sports information technology (spor bilişimi) venture providing digital management software, event discovery platforms, and sports content for sports clubs, businesses, and enthusiasts.
- [SportsFly – Case Study](https://selmanutku.com/projeler/sportsfly) | Official Website: https://sportsfly.com.tr — End-to-end digital management SaaS platform for sports academies, clubs, and athletic facilities.
